method: Annual label kWh is based on one full load per week. Divide by 52 for an indicative full rated-load cycle; multiply annual kWh by weekly loads and the assumed usage tariff for annual electricity cost. Compare 7kg and 8kg rated loads, not an equal-mass test. RRP payback is the 700 AUD difference divided by annual electricity savings, excluding other costs.
priceSourceNote: Manufacturer-authored fact sheets hosted by Bing Lee explicitly show the RRPs on page 1. Current Electrolux-generated fact sheets omit RRP. These are published RRP reference figures, not verified current selling prices or a claim that RRP has been freshly reaffirmed by the manufacturer.
